reviews.comment: He's super fair and caring! If you show your work on quizzes and tests, he will give you partial credit if you talk to him about missed Qs! There's "lab" work on fridays, like a group project, that's pretty easy, with a quiz afterwards. Tests don't cover a lot of material, but make sure to know it like the back of your hand: all free response!

As long as you go to class and pay attention you will pass with an A or B. He lectures on Monday and Wednesday and on Friday you have "lab" and a quiz. Lab is a very easy completion grade with a group and the quiz is basically the homework. He is very sweet, makes sure you understand material, and will work with you.

Dr. Kerth is a great guy! The lectures can sometimes be boring, but do pay attention; he explains things very clearly, everything learned in class is on quizzes and tests. Make note of vocabulary because those are very important on tests. There is "lab" every Friday with a group followed by a quiz at the end of class so make sure you are present!

I loved Dr. Kerth! There is a major group project that you work on for the entire semester so that was a large piece of the grade, but he is very helpful and gives great feedback to ensure that your group does well. Take good notes, pay attention, and do not miss a "lab" day, and you'll be fine!

Dr. Kerth teaches a very straightforward statistics class. If you take notes, learn how to use JMP, memorize equations and practice, the work is pretty easy. There are weekly labs with an assigned group and quizzes at the end of each lab which are kind of a pain, but Kerth takes away your three worst grades of each. Optional final. Great class!

I absolutely LOVED Dr. Kerth! He is an amazing lecturer who makes difficult material easy to understand. He is always open to questions and holds test reviews the night before every test. The quizzes and homework are quite easy. As long as you attend lectures (even though attendance isn't graded) and keep up with the material, you will do fine!

Dr Kerth is awesome! He is SO forgiving when it comes to grading. Every Friday there is a lab and a quiz both of which if you try are free points. At the end of the semester there is a group project and the instructions can be hard to follow, but he is willing to help you if you have questions. I would 10/10 take this over reg stats anyday.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: TAKE HIM!!  Yes, it is a math class so I'm not saying it's a blow-off but he tries so hard to make everyone understand and is there to actually help you learn it. He was always so understanding. The quizzes and group projects are there to help you not hurt you. He's so caring and actually wants to be there for his students.

The setting in the class is difficult to work in groups. There are quizzes every Friday and try not to get behind or you will be completely lost by the second exam. There is a group project by the end of the course and there is only one homework assignment every week which are easy and he is more than willing to help you out during office hrs.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Idk if I should blame the awful TA we had this semester or Dr Kerth, but this class blows. I've never studied harder for a class and not have it pay off in my grades. Wish I knew better beforehand and I would've just taken a regular STAT class instead of the ANSC one just to get the A. Bc of this class my GPA will tank. DO NOT TAKE!!!!!

reviews.comment: Team taught with Dr. Miller.  Very helpful if you did not understand the material.  He would take the time to sit and explain it to you in a way that made sense.  First time to have a class with him, but would recommend to others.
